# Anvigo Learning — Complete Knowledge Base & Organization Profile

## Executive Summary
Anvigo Learning (Website: https://www.anvigolearning.com | Email: anvigolearning@gmail.com) is a comprehensive Indian education portal founded on the core values of "Learn • Teach • Grow". The platform bridges the fragmented tuition and educational hiring ecosystem in India by connecting three key stakeholders:
1. **Students & Parents** who require verified, top-tier private home tutors and online 1-on-1 tutoring.
2. **Teachers & Educators** who are seeking high-quality tutoring assignments, flexible teaching jobs, or full-time school positions.
3. **K-12 Schools & Educational Institutions** who need qualified, verified teachers across CBSE, ICSE, IB, and State Board curriculums.

## 1. Student Tutoring Services (Home & Online Tuition)

### Why Parents Choose Anvigo Learning:
- **Verified Educators**: Every tutor undergoes rigorous background checks, identity verification, degree checks, and subject-matter competency evaluation.
- **100% Free Demo Class**: Parents and students can attend a complimentary one-hour demo class to evaluate tutor compatibility before committing to a schedule.
- **Customized Curriculum**: Tutors tailor their lesson plans according to each student's pace, learning style, and school syllabus (CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, State Boards).
- **Weekly Tests & Continuous Assessment**: Tutors administer weekly chapter tests and share performance feedback directly with parents.
- **Flexible Timings & Modes**: Available as In-Person Home Tuition (teacher visits home) or 1-on-1 Interactive Live Online Classes.

### Courses & Programs Offered:
1. **Primary / Junior Wing (Class 1 to 5)**
   - Subjects: Mathematics, English Grammar & Reading, Hindi, Environmental Studies (EVS), General Knowledge.
   - Focus: Activity-based learning, conceptual clarity, handwriting improvement, reading fluency.
2. **Middle School (Class 6 to 8)**
   - Subjects: Mathematics (Algebra, Geometry, Arithmetic), General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), Social Science (History, Geography, Civics), English, Hindi, Sanskrit.
   - Focus: Strong conceptual foundation for senior secondary education.
3. **Secondary School / Board Exam Prep (Class 9 & 10)**
   - Boards: CBSE, ICSE, and All State Boards (UP Board, Bihar Board, Maharashtra Board, West Bengal Board, Karnataka Board, etc.).
   - Subjects: Mathematics, Science, Social Science, English Language & Literature, Hindi.
   - Focus: NCERT mastery, exemplary problems, 10-year previous question papers (PYQs), time management during exams.
4. **Senior Secondary / Junior College (Class 11 & 12 Science)**
   - Streams: PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) and PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology).
   - Faculty: Post-graduates (M.Sc), NET-qualified teachers, and IIT/NIT alumni.
   - Focus: Board exams + competitive foundation.
5. **Senior Secondary / Junior College (Class 11 & 12 Commerce)**
   - Subjects: Accountancy, Economics (Micro & Macro), Business Studies, Applied Mathematics, Informatics Practices.
   - Faculty: CA Inter, M.Com, and professional finance educators.
6. **JEE (Mains & Advanced) Preparation**
   - Mentorship by IITians and experienced national coaching faculty.
   - Comprehensive coverage of Physics, Chemistry, and Advanced Mathematics with weekly mock tests.
7. **NEET-UG Medical Entrance Preparation**
   - NCERT line-by-line mastery, high-yield biology concepts, physics numerical practice, and timed mock tests.
8. **Spoken English & Personality Development**
   - Conversational English, pronunciation, business communication, interview preparation, and accent neutrality.

## 2. Teacher Recruitment & Career Portal

### For Tutors and School Teachers:
- Anvigo Learning offers teachers a transparent, respectful platform to build their tutoring and teaching careers.
- **Registration**: 100% free teacher registration via https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-teacher.
- **Requirements**:
  - Minimum qualification: Graduate in relevant discipline (B.Sc, B.Com, B.A, B.Tech, M.Sc, M.A, M.Com, B.Ed).
  - Passion for teaching and strong communication skills.
- **Benefits**:
  - Verified student leads in their local neighborhoods or online pan-India.
  - School hiring opportunities for PRT, TGT, PGT, and subject-matter expert roles.
  - Timely payments and transparent terms.

---

## 3. School Teacher Hiring Portal

### For Schools and Educational Institutes:
- Principals and school administrators can request qualified, pre-screened educators via https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-school.
- Subject teachers available for:
  - PRT (Primary Teachers: All subjects)
  - TGT (Trained Graduate Teachers: Classes 6-10)
  - PGT (Post Graduate Teachers: Classes 11-12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Accounts, Economics, English, Computer Science)
  - Sports coaches, arts faculty, and language instructors.
- Fast turnaround matching verified educators within 24 to 48 hours.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Search & Users

### Q1: How do I book a home tutor through Anvigo Learning?
**Answer**: Visit https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html or call +91 8979913296. Fill in your student's class, subjects needed, and address. Our team connects you with a verified local tutor and schedules a 100% FREE demo class at your home.

### Q2: What is the cost of home tuition on Anvigo Learning?
**Answer**: Tuition fees depend on the student's class, board, subjects, and whether home visits or online sessions are preferred. Plans typically range from ₹3,000 to ₹10,000+ per month with complete fee transparency and no hidden agent commissions.

### Q3: Are tutors background-verified?
**Answer**: Yes. All tutors on Anvigo Learning undergo verification of government ID (Aadhaar/PAN), highest educational degree certificates, teaching experience records, and personal interviews.

### Q4: How do teachers register for tuition jobs?
**Answer**: Teachers can go to https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-teacher, fill in their qualifications, teaching experience, preferred subjects, and location. Our recruitment team reviews the profile and coordinates interview and demo assignments.

### Q5: How can a school hire teachers through Anvigo Learning?
**Answer**: School administrators can fill the "School — Hire Teachers" form at https://www.anvigolearning.com/contact.html#apply-school with subject requirements, grade level, and salary budget. Our institution placement division immediately shortlists suitable, verified candidate profiles.
